adminReadback.runtimeScope: Read system values on BODY, not documentElement defaults.

rules: Active native roles; additional brand roles editable natively or centrally derived.
Do not assume Background passes as text on Primary/Secondary/Dark.
Picker Primary/Secondary contrast covers one pairing only.
Protect image-overlay copy independently of slide colors.
No demo fallback that silently ignores native admin changes.

findings.title: Literal and demo palettes bypass theme changes
findings.description: D/E native aliases are overridden by demo hex. B/C/G/H/I and F adapter use literal palettes. All16 parity payloads have literal hex and zero --q-* references.
findings.action: One-time shared implementation: remove reusable demo overrides, bind all paint roles to active native values, retain the same CSS across clients.

findings.title: Overlay source disables text shadows
findings.description: Original D/E/G/H/I hero source explicitly sets text-shadow:none!important. Some type is off-image; any text crossing imagery needs protection.
findings.action: Scoped text shadow plus backing/scrim or solid panel. Test every slide/light-dark frame; shadow alone cannot guarantee arbitrary-image contrast.
findings.partialClosure: 2026-10-25: Ma Light Text enabled and conflicting ink/shadow reset removed; published desktop/phone protected captions verified. D/E/G/H and broader overlay coverage remain uninstalled.

findings.title: Odd membership emphasis depends on position
findings.description: Tier1 --v-white/-1.5deg; tier2 --v-scrap/+1.5deg; tier3 --v-scrap-2/-.8deg. Scrap uses Accent, scrap2 uses Dark; CTA uses Primary. Demo hex bypasses active admin settings.
findings.action: Stable Primary/Secondary/Dark role classes and contrast-safe foregrounds. Keep slants as documented preset or expose finite class choices in native editor; no per-client CSS.

findings.title: Native editorial blocks still contain authored HTML
findings.description: Ten parity Text Blocks contain cards/anchors in bodyHtml. Original membership/hire tables contain static tier/rate copy. Native widget type is not proof of data bindings or individual card controls.
findings.action: Document exact editable fields/classes. Keep structure stable, change copy/links in intended editors, and distinguish editorial information from native products/inventory.

findings.title: Customer wording is generated by CSS
findings.description: Storybook hero injects Now showing; food injects Bill of fare. Ordinary content editors cannot update/localize these strings.
findings.action: Move meaningful text into native fields; generated CSS content for decoration only.

findings.title: Source-ID and DOM-dependent selectors are fragile to copying
findings.description: Selectors use source page slugs/IDs, generated section-name fragments, q-* wrappers and nth-child. Library copies can receive different identities/markup.
findings.action: Stable reusable section classes, scoped versioned adapters and a real destination-site copy/unlink test.

findings.title: Template fonts can override editable theme fonts
findings.description: Global/page rules pin Georgia/Arial and Bodoni Moda/Jost/IBM Plex Mono, often!important. Site CSS imports Google Fonts.
findings.action: Decide fixed design fonts versus editable typography roles; bind editable roles to verified native controls. Native font variable names unverified.

findings.title: Visible forms/CTAs do not prove service configuration
findings.description: J/K/L form journals show blank notification/submission recipients and no delivery test. Copies need local routes, products, channels and handling.
findings.action: Native build handoff checks and authorized functional validation before client launch.
